explainBack: AI is physical infrastructure: electricity creates emissions according to generation source; cooling can use water; hardware needs materials and becomes waste. Efficiency per task does not guarantee a lower total if demand grows faster.
unseenTransfer: A greener-per-task claim needs total use, task type, electricity source, local water and hardware, and demonstrated benefits.
sourceLimitations: IEA2026 supports current AI-focused growth, not attribution of all data centres to AI.
UNCTAD2024 supports shared infrastructure mechanisms only.
Neither supports a universal per-prompt footprint.
researchRoleDisclosed: Reviewer researched sources but did not draft or edit answer.
